verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public official GitHub repository (mudler/LocalAI) whose files can be read directly, and the vendor calls LocalAI "one open runtime", so the source is readable. However, no evidence names the license or confirms it is an OSI-style open license. missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., a LICENSE file or SPDX name), first-party statement that the code is open source under that license, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
The official mudler/LocalAI repository ships a full Swagger 2.0 specification of the REST API
